    Peptides for muscle growth, compared with what the FDA approved.

    Peptide Chooser editorial team. Checked 30 Oct 2026.

    Every claim links to its source.

    No peptide is FDA approved for building muscle. Tesamorelin is approved for one use only, belly fat in people with HIV, and sermorelin's approved product left the market years ago. The growth hormone peptides sold for muscle are research-use products with no approved version; we show their prices and checks and do not link to the shops.

    Compare the options
